name: manual_f82b87
claim: Before opening preservation PRs for every unmerged branch, first list remote branches not merged into origin/main and existing open PR heads; create PRs only for remote branches with no open PR, and include a future-agent warning to append rather than replace the PR summary.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14 batch preservation pass across orama-system and Perpetua-Tools showed gh pr list can return zero while dozens of remote branches remain unmerged. Duplicate prevention and summary preservation keep review/audit context intact.

rationale: 2026-07-14 batch preservation pass across orama-system and Perpetua-Tools showed gh pr list can return zero while dozens of remote branches remain unmerged. Duplicate prevention and summary preservation keep review/audit context intact.
